items.criterion: Navigate to Microsoft Playwright GitHub Releases page (no sign-in)
items.description: Agent accesses the microsoft/playwright repository and opens the Releases page (e.g., via the UI or direct /releases URL) without signing in. Full credit if Releases page content is reached unauthenticated, OR if GitHub blocks access (CAPTCHA/rate limit/geo restriction) and the agent clearly reports the blocker and what was attempted. Partial credit if the agent reaches a nearby page (e.g., tags page) and explains inability to reach Releases due to the blocker. No credit if a different repository is used or sign-in is required unnecessarily.

items.criterion: Identify newest non-preview release and record metadata
items.description: From the Releases list, identify the newest release that is not labeled as preview or pre-release (or equivalent, such as GitHub’s “Pre-release” badge). Report (a) release tag and (b) publication date. Full credit if both match the newest non-preview release shown; OR, if Releases cannot be accessed due to an external blocker, full credit for clearly stating the blocker and using the best available fallback visible on GitHub without sign-in (e.g., tags page or cached/partial Releases view) while noting any ambiguity. Partial credit if only one of tag/date is correct or if the selection is reasonable but the preview/non-preview status is ambiguous and not addressed. No credit if metadata is fabricated or clearly corresponds to an older/preview release when a newer non-preview release is visible.

items.criterion: Extract three changes from the release notes
items.description: Report three distinct changes listed in the release notes for the identified newest non-preview release. Full credit if all three are accurately taken from that release’s notes; OR, if the full release notes are not accessible due to external blocking/loading issues, full credit for extracting as many as are visible (up to three) and clearly stating the limitation. Partial credit if only 1–2 changes are correct/traceable or if one change comes from a different release due to an explained ambiguity. No credit if changes are invented or not traceable to any visible release notes content.

items.criterion: Verify one reported change using official Playwright documentation
items.description: Verify at least one of the three reported changes by consulting official Playwright documentation (playwright.dev or official Microsoft Playwright docs) and explaining how the docs confirm the change (link/section name or unambiguous reference). Full credit if the verification clearly ties a specific release-note change to an official doc page/section; OR, if official docs are inaccessible due to external factors (downtime, blocking), full credit for clearly reporting the access issue and providing a reasonable alternate verification attempt within official sources available without sign-in (e.g., documentation mirrored in the Playwright repo) while noting the limitation. Partial credit if docs are consulted but the linkage is weak/indirect. No credit if no verification attempt is made or only non-official sources are used.

Agent does not sign in and does not create issues/comments/PRs or make file changes. Agent stops after recording: release tag, publication date, three changes, and one documentation verification (allowing minimal additional steps if needed to diagnose/report external blockers). Full credit if constraints are respected and output stops at the requested point; partial credit if minor extra browsing/output occurs but constraints are still respected; no credit if prohibited interactions occur (sign-in, posting, or file changes).
